lines.2: 「Now then. Can I make one more round...?」
lines.3: 「...Hm? Someone else is climbing the wall.」
lines.7: 「C-climbing a wall is so embarrassing if anyone sees you... Ellie, your panties were showing.」
lines.8: 「I only did it because nobody was around. Nothing to be embarrassed about.」
lines.9: 「Princess! The student council president cannot behave like this!」
lines.10: 「Otome! Oh, crap! I can't believe you're watching a spot like this.」
lines.11: 「Ah, I knew it... This is what happens when you do something bad...」
